sloka: भविष्यति हि मे रूपम् प्लवमानस्य सागरम् ।विष्णोः प्रक्रममाणस्य तदा त्रीन् विक्रमान् इव ॥४-६७-२५॥
transliteration: bhaviṣyati hi me rūpam plavamānasya sāgaram ।viṣṇoḥ prakramamāṇasya tadā trīn vikramān iva ॥4-67-25॥

translations.english: 'Just as the lightning generated by the clouds lands at once flying in the sky without any support I can also land in less than a moment.
